sentences.text: Researchers analyzed semantic processing in a group of patients, identifying this activity in 12 percent of the individuals studied.

Those showing such signs were much more likely to regain consciousness, and the test became perfectly accurate for predicting consciousness recovery when patients with withdrawn life support or non-brain-related deaths were excluded.
The authors caution that these results are preliminary and need confirmation by larger studies before they can be used in clinical practice.
